🎬 Ao Haru Ride*

(also known as Blue Spring Ride)
2014 · romance/slice of life/shoujo/anime · 1 season
📜 storyline
high school girl Futaba Yoshioka wants to reset her life
and leave behind her past self. she reunites with her first
love, now known as Kou Mabuchi, who has changed
drastically from the kind boy she once knew. as they
reconnect, both struggle with personal trauma, identity,
and unspoken feelings. the story beautifully explores
young love, emotional growth, and the pain of moving
forward.

📖 title info
🖋️ Ao Haru Ride: popular shoujo anime based on the
manga by Io Sakisaka
📅 first aired: july 8, 2014
🎨 studio: Production I.G
👤 main characters:
Futaba Yoshioka
Kou Mabuchi
Yuri Makita
Shuko Murao
📊 total episodes: 12 (+ OVA)
⏱️ runtime: ∼23-24 minutes per episode
🌍 language: japanese original with subtitles/dubs
⭐ imdb rating: ∼7.5-7.8/10
🏆 acclaim: loved for its realistic romance,
emotional
depth, and relatable characters.
📺 where to watch
Ao Haru Ride is available on Rakuten Viki.
